entities.summary: Grantley Adams, a notable figure in the history of Barbados, associated with Labour Movement and Path to Self-Governance (1946–1965). Preceded by West Indies Federation and Grantley Adams founds Barbados Labour Party 1938. Their legacy influenced Grantley Adams becomes Prime Minister of West Indies Federation 1958 and West Indies Federation dissolves 1962.
